en: A shoal of glass shrimp, hundreds of clear bodies moving as one. They swarm to lamplight and leave as fast as they came.
A limpet the size of a door, fixed across a passage of a drowned tower. It barely moves, and it has all day.
It lives on the lamp oil divers spill, and it smothers light rather than strikes. Its fat would burn well, if anyone carried fire down there.
A hollow black carapace with too many legs, come up out of the storm's overflow. Cyan light bleeds from its seams and sinks.
A storm-spawned eel that grew through a drowned ship's rib-cage and wears the black timbers like a corset. When the raft breaks, so do the ribs.
Choose a command, then its target, then confirm.
Blinded? Brine Eyewash, under Items, clears your eyes.
A fight the story doesn't need can be fled.
Every action costs time. Watch the order shift before you choose: quick strikes bring your next turn sooner.
Kick Off the Wall costs almost no time. Use it to take your turns before Hullgnaw takes its own.
The brass rim of a Lit Age tide-gauge, two metres across, cut free in one piece. Its teeth are worth a month's oil.
A fresh wick from Mother Kell's own spool, pressed into your hand for luck. Every diver gets one going down.
